Commentary.Commentary: Right then, England have displayed some great character in this second ODI and we have an exciting decider coming up on Sunday, 24th of July. That game will be played at Headingley, Leeds and it will start at 3.30 pm IST (10 am GMT). Our build-up though will begin earlier. So do join us for the same. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Sam Curran is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his crucial knock of 35 from just 18 balls and an important wicket of David Miller with the ball in hand. He says that he tries to bat with the batter’s mindset and during an injury he had some thinking to do and wanted to be consistent with the bat. Tells that the message is always to pick the positive option and it was all about picking the right ball. Mentions that he wants to be adaptable and wants to give Buttler different options and everytime he plays for England, he tries to do his best.

Jos Buttler, the skipper of England says that it feels great to have a win and the way the bowlers picked up early wickets, that set the tone of the game. He is pretty happy with the overall performance of his players and says that they look to put pressure on the opposition whenever they can. He mentions that he and Liam had a chat in the middle and decided to pick the right bowlers to go after and change gears. He says that ultimately he was happy with the total on this pitch as this pitch was not that easy to bat for the new batters  He adds Topley and Willey bowled brilliantly and they will look to continue this to the series decider on Sunday.

Keshav Maharaj, the skipper of South Africa says that the target was chaseable and they did not bat well and if one loses four wickets in the Powerplay, it becomes difficult. Tells that they need to be better with the bat and it is back to the drawing board. Mentions that he enjoys captaincy and it gives a different perspective on the field and says that the media attention is the part and parcel of the job.
Presentation time...

Earlier in the day, after a long delay because of rain, England were inserted to bat by the South African skipper. They kept losing wickets but managed to score at a healthy rate. They finished with around 200 in the 29 overs alloted to them and that proved to be more than enough as they defended it quite easily.

For South Africa, after an impressive performance with the bat in the last game, it was a sorry outing for them in this game. Their top order had no answers to the movement earlier on and the middle and the lower order could not handle the spinners. In the end, it was quite a poor show with the bat by them.

Early wickets is what they needed and they got plenty! Reece Topley continued his impressive form and David Willey gave him really good support. They had England 5 down in no time. The visitors just never recovered. The only thing which could save them was rain which did arrive but it was not hard enough to take the players off the field. England however, managed to take the remaining wickets, Adil Rashid and Moeen did well to not only bowl the overs quickly but get the remaining wickets too.

A very comprehensive win for England and they have levelled the series! We did mention this was a competitive total but the way England performed with the ball, it seemed like they had a total which was well above par.

OUT! CAUGHT! That is it for this game and England win by 118 runs. This is slower through the air on off, Anrich Nortje dances down the track to heave it over long on but did not manage to get to the pitch of the ball and mistimes his shot. The ball goes high in the air and Moeen Ali at long on takes an easy catch. This has been an excellent performance by England as they level the series.
Commentary.Howout: c Jonny Bairstow b Moeen Ali

Commentary.Commentary: Quicker and flatter on middle, Tabraiz Shamsi flicks it through mid-wicket for one.
Tossed up on middle, Tabraiz Shamsi knocks it down the pitch.
Tossed up on off. Nortje drives it to long off for a single.

NOT OUT! This is flatter on middle. Shamsi looks to clip it away but gets the inside edge onto his pads. England appeal and the umpire raises his finger. However, Shamsi take a review and the UltraEdge shows that there is bat involved. Shamsi will continue as the decision will be overturned.
FOUR! Good shot! Tossed up on middle. Shamsi skips down the track and hits it straight down the ground for a boundary.
Darted around leg. Shamsi looks to clip it away but misses. The ball deflects off his pads towards the leg side.
Tabraiz Shamsi is the last man in for South Africa.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Adil Rashid gets his third wicket and England are just one wicket away now from a big victory. This is on the shorter side and on off. The ball holds a bit off the surface and Lungi Ngidi looks to push it away. However, he ends up playing it early and the ball loops up straight back to the bowler. Rashid takes an easy catch off his own bowling.
Floated on off, Lungi Ngidi is solid in his defense.
Tossed up full on middle, Anrich Nortje drills it to long on for one.
Another one that skids on, it is outside off. Ngidi looks to defend but misses.
This is outside off and fuller. Lungi Ngidi looks to drive it away from his body. The ball goes off the thick outside edge to short third man.
A fuller delivery, around off. Lungi Ngidi drives it to covers.
Beaten again! This is around off and pushed quicker again, around off. Lungi Ngidi gets betaen off the outside edge.
A fuller delivery on off. Ngidi hits it to mid on.
A flatter delivery, around off. Lungi Ngidi pushes forward to defend but gets beaten on the outisde edge.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Angled into the pads, Nortje looks to drive but misses to get hit on the pads.
Shorter and outside off, Nortje looks to cut but misses.
Almost another one! The googly, it lands outside off and spins back in. Nortje looks to cut but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Lungi Ngidi walks out to the middle now.

OUT! TAKEN! That should be the final nail in the coffin, if not nailed before! Rashid gets another one. This is tossed up outside off, Dwaine Pretorius looks to go over covers. He miscues it and Roy takes a good catch running behind.
Commentary.Howout: c Jason Roy b Adil Rashid

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and on off, Dwaine Pretorius pushes it to covers.
Done with 17 overs after that single! Shorter and outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
FOUR! THUMPED! On middle, fuller, right in the slot. This is hammered over the bowler's head for a boundary.
A single as this is pushed down to long on.
More runs! Flatter and on off, Nortje looks to cut, it goes off the outside edge down towards third man for two.
Yet another dot! On middle, Nortje plays it to mid-wicket.
Flatter and on middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
A dot to end! On off, this is pushed to cover. 24 more balls to get a result in this game.
BEATEN! Shorter and outside off, this one turns back in. Dwaine Pretorius looks to cut but is beaten.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed to covers.
On off, defended.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Anrich Nortje is the next batsman in for South Africa.

OUT! TIMBER! Another one bites the dust! That one skid through! Probably because of the rain as till now the wicket seemed to be holding a touch. On off, this one skids through. Maharaj is unsure whether to come forward or play back, in the end, he is late in getting his bat down, the ball sneaks through and hits the off pole. England only three wickets away now.
Beaten! This one skids on again, it is around of and Dwaine Pretorius looks to defend it. However, the ball goes just past the outside edge of his blade back to Buttler.
On the shorter side, around off. Keshav Maharaj pushes it to short third man for a single.
Keshav Maharaj, the skipper comes out to the middle now.

OUT! STUMPED! Moeen Ali outfoxes Heinrich Klaasen and really the only thing that can stop England from winning this game from hereon is rain and that too if it comes before the end of 20 overs. Heinrich Klaasen skips down the track and Ali pulls his length back a bit. It is around off and Heinrich Klaasen plays for the turn as he looks to work it towards the leg side. The ball skids off the surface and beats the outside edge of the blade. Buttler behind the stumps collects the ball and whips the bails off as Heinrich Klaasen is well out of his crease.
Commentary.Howout: st Jos Buttler b Moeen Ali

Commentary.Commentary: A flatter one, around off. Heinrich Klaasen defends it towards the off side.
FOUR! Good shot! Shorter in length and outside off. Heinrich Klaasen goes back and slaps it towards deep extra-cover fence for a boundary.
A fuller delivery on middle. Dwaine Pretorius works it to mid-wicket for a single.

Drinks! England are right on top in this game at the moment. Just like South Africa they have picked up 5 wickets too before drinks. On the other hand, South Africa will be hoping that they can do the same like England and build a partnership to get close to the target. There is some drizzling and England are looking to complete 20 overs as soon as possible to get a result out of this match.
Two more! Lucky runs! On middle, Klaasen goes for the slog sweep this time, it goes off the inner half down to fine leg for two.
Tossed up on off, Klaasen sweeps it but it goes off the inner half to short fine leg.
Uppish but wide! Tossed up on off, Dwaine Pretorius hits it hard back to the left of the bowler who sticks a hand out but it goes past it and down to long off for one.
On off, this is hit to cover.
A single as this is hit down to long on.
That has probably slipped out! A full toss on middle, this is paddle swept fine for two.
Two more! Shorter in length and outside off, this is cut through point for one.
On the shorter side again, this is hit hard to mid offbut only one.
Shorter and around off, Klaasen slaps it hard but to covers.
EDGY RUNS! No slip in place! Shorter and outside off, Klaasen looks to cut but it goes off the outside edge down to third man for one.
Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for another run.
Flatter and on middle, this is pushed to mid-wicket.
Moeen Ali comes into the attack in place of Sam Curran.
A single to end he over! 12 gone, 8 more for a result. On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Tossed up on off, this is hit down to long off for one.
Good effort! Tossed up on off, Dwaine Pretorius looks to drive, the fielder at mid off, dives to his right and looks to stop it but makes a half stop. A single.
Shorter and outside off, this is cut behind point on the off side for one.
Floats it up on off, DP looks to drive but it goes off the inner half to mid-wicket.
Klaasen shapes up for the sweep but this is bowled short and outside off, it is slapped through covers for one.
WIDE! Slips this one down the leg side. Wided. Wides won't help.
Sharp! A bumper on middle, Dwaine Pretorius evades it. 11 overs done, 9 more overs for a completed game.
A single to end! Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Extra bounce! Length and on middle, this one takes off. Dwaine Pretorius looks to defend but misses. The ball goes off his pads towards the leg side and a leg bye is taken.
Back of a length and on off, defended.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Short and on middle, this is pulled but to mid-wicket.

There is a slight drizzle at the moment! These are not good signs for England, they are right on top but need to complete 20 overs to get a result here. There is some problem around the sight screen area as well and this will frustrate England further. The boundary advertisement board were pulled out to bring covers back quickly if the rain comes back harder and Heinrich Klaasen had a problem with that. However, all good now and we are all set to resume again.
The googly comes out, full and on middle, Heinrich Klaasen drills it to long off for another single.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! This is a bit short on middle and off, Heinrich Klaasen makes room for himself and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Adil Rashid bowls the slider but down the leg again, Heinrich Klaasen helps it on his way towards fine leg for a brace.
Tossed up on middle, Heinrich Klaasen knocks it to short mid-wicket.
WIDE! This is flatter and quicker down leg, Heinrich Klaasen misses his flick. It is called a wide.
Short and on leg, Dwaine Pretorius works it through square leg for a single.
Starts with a leg break on off, Heinrich Klaasen punches it to long off for one.
Full again and outside off, Dwaine Pretorius slashes it past short covers for a brace. He gets off the mark.
Full and on off, Dwaine Pretorius blocks it to the off side.
Dwaine Pretorius walks out to the middle.

OUT! BOWLED! Sam Curran gets a wicket in his first over and it is a big wicket. He uses the cutter this time. This is on a length around off, skids off the surface and comes into the left hander. David Miller did not pick it up and gets beaten as he looks to punch it away. The ball goes crashing into the stumps. South Africa needed something special from Miller but sadly it will not be a case today.
Full and down the leg, Heinrich Klaasen flicks it through square leg for one.
Good delivery by Curran. He bowls it on a length outside off, this one holds its line, Heinrich Klaasen is into his shot and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Sam Curran starts with a full delivery outside off, Heinrich Klaasen again tries to guide it to third man but mistimes it to point.
Sam Curran is into the attack. He can swing the ball too. He is going to start from 'round the wicket.
Good length and on off, skidding through of the surface, David Miller blocks it to point.
BEAUTY! David Willey pulls his length back a bit on off, gets this one to swing away from the left hander. David Miller throws his bat at it without any footwork and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Goes full and on off, David Miller blocks it to short covers.
On a length and outside off, Heinrich Klaasen pushes it to third man for one.
A bit full and down the leg, Heinrich Klaasen flicks it toward mid-wicket, there is misfiled and the batters picks up a double.
Starts with a back of a length delivery on middle, Heinrich Klaasen looks to work it to the leg side but ends up knocking it onto the ground.
Hard length from Topley on leg, Heinrich Klaasen whips it away through square leg for another run.
Good length and on off, David Miller easily works it towards third man for a single.
On a length and outside off, swinging away, David Miller lets it go to the keeper.
Good length and outside off, Heinrich Klaasen opens the face of his bat and guides it to third man for one.
Tight from Topley. This is again full and on middle, Heinrich Klaasen knocks it towards point.
Full and on middle, David Miller blocks it with his inner half to the leg side. They cross.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now, a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 23th over.
Fullish delivery and outside off, Heinrich Klaasen drives it firmly towards covers. England are right on top after the powerplay.
On a length and on lig, Heinrich Klaasen works it to short mid-wicket.
Goes full this time and on middle, David Miller gets acorss and drives it with his inner hald towards short mid on. They cross.
Pulls his length back a bit around off, David Miller guides it towards point.
Good length onto the pads, Heinrich Klaasen helps it to fine leg for one.

BEATEN! David Willey bowls it on a length from 'round the wicket and on off, angling away, Heinrich Klaasen looks to play at it but gets beaten on the outside edge. The bounce looks uneven as this one kept low.
FOUR! This time a more authorative shot! Overpitched delivery on off. Miller leans forward and shows the full face of his blade as he drives it past mid off for a boundary.

FOUR! Ohh..the fielder at point got a finger-tip to it but luckliy for Miller the ball does not stick in his hand and runs away for a boundary. This is a fullish delivery, outside off. Miller drives it on the up and gets it off the outside half of his blade. The ball goes through the point region for a boundary.
Back of a length, on middle. Heinrich Klaasen works it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Lands on a length, on middle. Heinrich Klaasen works it to mid-wicket.
Serves it on a length and outside off. It swings away and Miller throws his bat at it. The ball goes off the thick outside edge to third man for a single.
A wide yorker, outside off. Heinrich Klaasen squeezes it to third man for a single.
On a length, on middle. Miller works it towards the leg side.
David Miller comes out to the middle now. Can he be the man to take South Africa out of trouble?

OUT! RUN OUT! This is disaster for South Africa as Aiden Markram departs without even facing a delivery! He was the in-form batter and this is a big blow for the Proteas. This is a fullish delivery swinging into middle. Heinrich Klaasen looks to work it towards the leg side but misses. The ball goes off his pads behind square on the leg side. Aiden Markram calls for a quick single and Buttler behind the stumps is aware and does brilliantly to collect the ball and fires a direct hit at the batter's end. The replays show that Markram is out of his crease and South Africa are in huge trouble here.
Tad fuller and around off. Heinrich Klaasen looks to drive it away but gets the inside edge onto his pads.
On a length, on middle. Heinrich Klaasen defends it towards the leg side.
Lands on a length and it is angled across the batter. Heinrich Klaasen leaves it alone.
Heinrich Klaasen is the next batsman in for South Africa.

OUT! CAUGHT! Now, David Willey gets into the act and gets a big fish, Quinton de Kock! England are on a roll here. Just short of good length, around off. Quinton de Kock looks to turn it away towards the leg side but does so a bit early. He ends up getting a leading edge towards short cover and Liam Livingstone dives forward to takes a fine catch. South Africa will be feeling the heat now!
Commentary.Howout: c Liam Livingstone b David Willey

Commentary.Commentary: Aiden Markram walks out to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Two in the over for Topley and England are right back in this game now! Some people will term this as an unfortunate dismissal but Rassie van der Dussen has played his part in this wicket. Topley lands it on a length, around leg. Rassie van der Dussen goes a bit across again and looks to clip it away. He gets a fine part of his blade and the ball goes to Buttler behind the stumps who takes it comfortably. Had Rassie van der Dussen played it staying still in his crease, the result would have been probably different.
Commentary.Howout: c Jos Buttler b Reece Topley

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, on off. Rassie van der Dussen goes a bit across and defends it towards the leg side.
Serves it a bit full and around off. Rassie van der Dussen tries to push it away but the ball nips back and the ball goes off the inside edge of his blade onto his pads.
Lands on a length and outside off. Rassie van der Dussen leaves it alone.
Rassie van der Dussen comes out to bat at Number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Reece Topley strikes! He has been among wickets in this format in recent times and provides an early breakthrough yet again when his team needed it the most. This is a fullish delivery on middle. Malan looks to lift it over the in-field. However, he gets no timing on this one and ends up hitting it straight towards mid on. Curran takes an easy catch and English bowlers are bowling quite well with this new ball.
Commentary.Howout: c Sam Curran b Reece Topley

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, around off. Malan defends it towards the off side.
WIDE! Topley angles it across the batter, It is fuller and way outside off. Malan throws his bat at it but misses.
Play and a miss! This one is just short of full length and around off. Quinton de Kock looks to drive it straight but gets beaten.
Willey goes full and angles it on leg. Quinton de Kock looks to flick it away but misses. The ball hits his pads and goes towards the off side.
FOUR! Nicely played! Goes fuller on middle. Quinton de Kock just lifts it with a straight blade over mid on for a boundary.
This is fuller and outside off. Quinton de Kock drives but straight to the cover fielder.
Back of a length, around off. Quinton de Kock chops it to point.
On a length, on off. Quinton de Kock looks to drive it but gets the inside edge onto his pads.
David Willey will share the attack with Reece Topley.
Beaten! On a good length and angled across the right-hander. Malan looks to drive it away from his body but misses.
Lands on the off stump line, on a length and nips back in. Malan looks to clip it away but gets hit high on his pads.
Lands on a length, on off. Malan defends it towards the off side.

NOT OUT! Topley serves a fullish delivery that swings back into leg. Malan looks to flick it away but misses. The ball hits his pads and loops up in the air towards the bowler. Topley runs forward and takes the catch. English players appeal but the umpire turns the appeal down. However, England review but ends up wasting it as the UltraEdge shows no bat involved.
South Africa and Quinton de Kock are underway! A fullish delivery, outside off. Quinton de Kock drives but gets a thick outside edge to deep backward point for a single.
Lovely delivery to start! Serves a good-length delivery outside off. Quinton de Kock looks to drive it away. However, the ball moves away and beats the outside edge of his blade.
